title: Launch tone presets (7 tones)
what_it_does: Seven written tone presets (default, polished, yc-parody, chaotic, deadpan, cinematic, app-store), each fixing voice, typography, scene count and length, hook, highlight and outro style, and transition.
when_to_use: At setup, to let the person pick how their launch videos sound; store the pick in the brand file.
why: MIT, plain text, no dependencies, and it is the part of brag we have not yet taken. Rewrite examples so no brag branding remains; keep the MIT notice and attribution.
